findings.governingReading: 五戦 names the five attacks just enumerated by five individual Servants, each repelled in a deadly fight.
findings.explanation: Five separate fights become five wars.

findings.highlight: The mountain is able to calmly enjoy the darkness
findings.governingReading: 山門 is the guarded temple gate that peacefully consumes darkness thanks to its defender.
findings.explanation: The temple gate becomes the mountain.

findings.governingReading: The crescent sword trajectory is so beautiful the absent moon would be ashamed.
findings.explanation: The appears twice in the sword-arc sentence.
